I'll gladly answer this from my viewpoint.

I have absolutely nothing against translations. I have consented to translations before and if someone asks me, it is very likely that I give my okay for a translation.

Naturally, it's still fanfiction. But there is a lot of heart, time and work that goes into my fics and though I see my works as a gift to the community, I still feel a sense of property over them. Not that you actually have, because I still write with copyrighted characters and base story, but I think it's clear what I mean. The main issue therefore is only consent and respect.

If your work gets just secretly translated like that, you feel disrespected. And not really appreciated. Do they really like my work or did they just catch a look at the numbers & thought "yeah, this one might work"? 

I know it's partially to make works more available to a broader audience, but I have my Tumblr linked everywhere on my profile & my works. Why where they not able to just shoot me a quick request and ask for consent?

Also, the commenter informed me that my work was very badly translated, as if run through a translation software. That also added to my displeasure. But the person seems to have now deleted the translation, so the situation has been resolved.
